name: Sorcerer Changing Caster
body:
Some doppelkin have innate magic from their doppelganger parentage. Instead of expressing more doppelganger traits, they are able to modify their spells like they do themselves.

Requirement: A mutable mage must be a doppelkin.

Mutable Components (Su)

At 1st level, once per day per class level, a changing caster can gain the benefits of either Silent Spell or Still Spell to any spell they cast without increasing the casting time, increasing the spell level, or needing the metamagic feat. This ability replaces bloodline and the bloodline power gained at 1st level.

Mutable Spells

At 4th level and every 4 levels thereafter, a changing caster can learn a spell up to one level lower than their highest spell level from any other spell list. If the spell would be from a 4-level spellcasting class, increase the spell level by 1 for this purpose. This ability replaces all bloodline spells.

Mutable Time (Su)

At 3rd level, a number of times per day equal to their Charisma modifier, a changing caster can cast a spell with a duration greater than 1 round and a casting time of 1 standard action, as a swift action. However, the spell’s duration is reduced to 1 round. This ability replaces the 3rd level bloodline power.

Metamagic Mastery

At 7th, 13th, and 19th levels, a changing caster gains a bonus metamagic feat for which they meet the prerequisites. This ability replaces all bloodline feats.

Mutable Space (Su)

At 9th level, a changing caster can manipulate the spacial properties of the spells they cast. A number of times per day equal to their Charisma modifier, the changing caster can do one of the following.

Use a touch spell as a ranged touch spell with a range of 30 feet.
Alter spaces within a burst, emanation, spread, cylinder, or line so that specified squares are excluded from the effect. They can affect up to 1 5-foot square per Charisma modifier.
Shape walls in 5-foot increments instead of 10-foot ones.

Change the affected area to any other within the same size group as follows:

Group 1: 15-foot cone, 10-foot-radius (40 foot high) cylinder, 30-foot line, or 5-, 10-, or 15-foot radius sphere;
Group 2: 30-foot cone, 20-foot-radius (40 foot high) cylinder, 60-foot line, or 20- or 30-foot radius sphere;
Group 3: 60-foot cone, 40-foot-radius (40 foot high) cylinder, 120-foot line, or 40- or 80-foot radius sphere. If the spell targets a number of creatures that require no two of the affected creatures be further than a certain distance apart, you can instead halve that distance but be from one specific creature.

You can apply multiple changes to the same spell, but each requires their own daily use. This ability replaces the 9th-level bloodline power.

Metamagic Ease (Ex)

At 15th level, a changing caster can reduce the spell level increase of a metamagic feat by 1. This does not change the increased casting time of the spell and cannot reduce the spell level increase below +0. This ability is usable a number of times per day equal to their Charisma modifier. This ability cannot be applied multiple times for the same spell, though the spell can still be affected by multiple metamagic spells. This ability replaces the 15th-level bloodline power.

Mutable Master (Su)

At 20th level, the changing caster no longer increases the casting time to apply a metamagic feat to a spell. Additionally, mutable components, mutable time, and mutable space can be used at will. This ability replaces the 20th-level bloodline power.
